timmys-logistics.title: Timmy's Pizza · Geospatial Demand & Fleet Routing
timmys-logistics.challenge: High delivery latency (38-minute average) and elevated perishable waste (7.3%) across 14 commercial outlets caused by disconnected POS, CRM, and kitchen systems.
timmys-logistics.architecture: Built a Python geospatial routing model ingesting 18,400 delivery logs combined with a 7-day predictive demand-forecasting pipeline (PostgreSQL + Python) feeding operational Power BI views.
timmys-logistics.highlights: Consolidated POS, delivery logistics, and CRM into a unified warehouse schema with automated nightly ETL synchronization.

sngpl-procurement.title: SNGPL · Automated Procurement & Vendor Risk Engine
sngpl-procurement.challenge: Static quarterly reporting and 12-day vendor evaluation cycles led to procurement budget friction and delayed critical delivery pipelines.
sngpl-procurement.architecture: Engineered a 15-metric vendor scorecard model fed by 6 years of SQL transaction records, coupled with a Python delivery-prediction pipeline analyzing 4,200 purchase orders.
metrics: PKR 4.7M Direct Budget Savings via Mid-Cycle Reallocations
66% Faster Vendor Evaluation Cycles (12 days → 4 days)
sngpl-procurement.highlights: Replaced static spreadsheets with drill-through interactive cost matrices surfacing budget variances.

mockforge-desktop.title: MockForge · Native System Design Studio & Heuristic Simulator
mockforge-desktop.challenge: System design interview tools rely on sluggish cloud roundtrips with high latency, lacking offline heuristic feedback on single points of failure (SPOF).
mockforge-desktop.architecture: Local-first native desktop architecture with Rust/Tauri v2 IPC, zero-lag React Flow node canvas, DuckDB telemetry cache, and local SAPI audio synthesis.
metrics: < 12ms Local IPC Latency via Native Rust Handlers
Automated AST-Style Node Validation & SPOF Detection
mockforge-desktop.highlights: Offline speech feedback with real-time heuristic structural analysis of distributed system topology.
